oas.pcSay: I confess the hunger I called to you with.
oas.pcDo: I confess the hunger I called to you with.
oas.pcSayRaw: Not here. Not in front of them.
oas.pcDoRaw: I set the ledger flat and leave my hand on it
oas.liDialogue: Speak it then, by root and storm, so every witness knows the oath you tried to bind me in.
oas.liAction: His hand tightens around mine on the Answer.
